name: Machine Shrug
steps: Stand tall centered between the handles of a shrug machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and grip both handles firmly at your sides with arms straight.
Brace your core, keep your chest upright, and let your shoulders hang slightly down into a mild stretch.
Shrug both shoulders straight up toward your ears by contracting your upper traps strongly.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower the handles slowly back down to the starting stretch.
tips: Move your shoulders strictly straight up and down instead of rolling them forward or backward.
Keep your elbows straight so your biceps do not assist the shrug.
